[
  {
    "id": "houserules.template-is-the-source",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Edit the kit in `template/`, then run `houserules update --dir .`; never hand-edit the root copies or the generated rules and skill.",
    "body": [
      "This repository runs its own kit. The root copies of every `KIT_OWNED` path — `tools/`, `.claude/agents/`, and the kit skills — are the installed copy; `template/` is the source that `init` and `update` ship to every project.",
      "`crates/houserules/tests/dogfood.rs` pins every root copy to its template source byte for byte (ported from `tests/dogfood.test.mjs`, retired at batch 20 T3, HR-047); a hand edit fails the test and is lost on the next update. `update` runs through the compiled `houserules` binary (batch 18 T6, docs/specs/2026-09-05-batch-18-phase3.md §4); `bin/houserules.mjs` retired outright at batch 20 T3 along with the rest of the JS toolchain (`houserules.payload-runs-on-builtins`).",
      "`.claude/rules/*.md` and `.claude/skills/project-knowledge/SKILL.md` are generated by `houserules render` from `knowledge/`."
    ],
    "tags": [
      "dogfood",
      "template",
      "update"
    ],
    "source": {
      "date": "2026-08-31",
      "by": "user",
      "ref": "docs/design.md §5.5"
    },
    "verify": [
      "crates/houserules/tests/dogfood.rs",
      "crates/houserules/src/install.rs"
    ],
    "topic": "houserules"
  }
]
